detail.longDescription: 🚀 Gitea 28.2.0 is here! This release includes important security fixes, along with improvements to Gitea Actions, pull requests, authentication, and package management. 🔒 Security fixes 🛠️ Bug fixes across the platform 📦 39 merged PRs from our community We strongly recommend upgrading! 👉 https:// blog.gitea.com/release-of-28.2 .0/ # Gitea # OpenSource # DevOps
